description: Base-line values and outcomes of the corner-face finite-resolution studies; see tests/_support/resolution_studies.py.
study_source: Validate run 45965021952 (commit fe4590df, 2026-11-27; the study and line code equal main 0ca09a07), source and installed partitions on ubuntu-latest, macos-15 and windows-latest
